children: Airbus said it won a 25-year cybersecurity contract from the French armed forces.
The European aerospace and defense group said Wednesday that its cyber business would supply cybersecurity gateways for the networks of the French Ministry of the Armed Forces and Veterans' Affairs.
The gateways will help enable classified data exchanges, it said.
